title: Earmark: fund a budget
description: Moves USDC from the treasury into an Earmark budget. Only the DAO can fund a budget; anything else is refunded.

fields.name: budget_id
fields.label: Budget number
fields.help: Shown in the budget's address on Earmark: /budgets/0 is budget 0.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Amount
fields.help: In USDC's smallest unit: 1 USDC = 1000000, 0.25 USDC = 250000.

summary: Fund Earmark budget {{budget_id}} with {{amount}} (USDC base units)
